description: This file contains functions related to platform upgrade procedures for a device running OpenWrt, including image verification, copying configuration, and performing upgrades with partition management.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the partition layout of the image matches the current device, ensuring compatibility before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the device's partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade by comparing partition tables, writing images to disks, and updating UUIDs.
